# Unified_Computational_Model

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A theoretical model that represents both topological and neuromorphic computations within a single formal framework for cross-domain analysis. Provides a common mathematical basis for evaluating and comparing TCC and iNEST approaches, accelerating cross-pollination of ideas.
